correctness.rationale: For the diameter-two rook graph, a forbidden selected triple is exactly a three-edge path in the corresponding complete-bipartite incidence graph. The connected bipartite three-edge-path-free components are stars, giving a literal bijection. Enumerating uniquely typed labeled components yields exp(ue^{vz}+ve^{uz}-uvz); formal differentiation gives the recurrence. The extremal component argument yields all parameter regimes including 2-by-n and 2-by-2. Independent geodesic and incidence-graph tests checked 576650 concrete subsets over 50 boards; exact coefficient and extremal tests checked 484 side-size pairs. These finite tests are corroborative, not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: General-position polynomials were defined as natural enumerative refinements in arxiv:2401.05696. Counting every general-position subset of two-parameter complete-factor products is a motivated complete classification, not a single arbitrary numerical case. The star-forest EGF gives all coefficients and a finite integer-polynomial recurrence, while leading multiplicities sharpen the known scalar gp number. It has clear reusability for labeled weighted counting, even without a downstream theorem or asymptotic result.
